text:
olivia (events): Quick sync — running a 30-min micro-webinar next Thurs 11am PT. Need: reg page (single-field), Zoom config + cloud recording backup, 3-min highlight clip + transcript within 24h, and HubSpot lead routing tagged micro-webinar-0426. Who takes which piece?

maria (marketing): I can make the reg page. Prefer 1 field (email) + optional company field. A/B two subject lines for reminder (short vs benefit).

sam (growth): +1 single-field. Add a consent checkbox: "Yes, I want product updates" (must be opt-in). Also capture utm_source param for ad tagging.

kevin (eng-ops): Zoom config notes — enable cloud recording (backup) + local host recording. Turn on auto-transcribe. Recording settings: record active speaker + gallery, separate audio files, and generate .srt. Also enable "Allow participants to join before host" = off.

olivia (events): Good call on both recordings — cloud as automated transcript source, local as highest-quality master. Kevin, can you set a post-recording webhook to drop raw assets to s3: rw-mktg/webinars/micro-0426/?

kevin (eng-ops): Yep. Will attach Zoom webhook -> Lambda that moves files to S3 and kicks off the clips job. Plan: s3 key prefix = micro-0426/raw/{meeting_id}/. Lambda will POST a job to clips service.

kevin (eng-ops): Example of the minimal lambda trigger config:
```json
{
  "source_bucket": "zoom-temp-recordings",
  "dest_prefix": "rw-mktg/webinars/micro-0426/raw/",
  "post_job_endpoint": "https://video-clipper.internal/jobs"
}
```

zoe (creative): For the 3-min highlight, let's pull 3 clips: intro (30s), demo highlight (120s), CTA (30s). I'll make a 16:9 thumbnail template. Deliverable: clip + transcript SRT + short social cut (30s).

maria (marketing): Post-event sequence: 0-6h automated email: replay + ask to download benchmark one-pager if they watched full clip. 24h follow-up: highlight clip with transcript + CTA to book demo. Tags: micro-webinar-0426, watched-replay (yes/no).

sam (growth): HubSpot mapping: form -> list "Micro Webinar 0426". Routing rule: if company_domain != gmail/hotmail then notify AE (sales@) via slack channel #sales-inbox, else nurture flow. I'll set conditional: company present => leadscore +10.

olivia (events): Consent language for reg page (copy suggestion): "I agree to receive event materials and occasional product updates from Redwood Inference. Unsubscribe anytime." Is that ok legal-wise?

maria (marketing): Works. We'll include a required privacy link and an optional checkbox for research followups.

kevin (eng-ops): One more ops detail — Zoom cloud transcripts can miss speaker tags. Add Speaker Diarization on processing step in clips job so SRT has speaker labels. Will add a job param: "diarize": true.

zoom-bot: Recording scheduled: meeting 987-654-321 on 2026-04-26T18:00:00Z. Cloud recording enabled. Auto-transcription on. Webhook configured to https://hooks.redwood-internal/zoom-recording.

olivia (events): Perfect. Action items: maria = reg page + email copy (due Tue EOD), kevin = zoom/webhook + lambda (due Wed AM), zoe = clip template + thumbnail (due Wed PM), sam = HubSpot mapping + routing (due Wed EOD). I'll run the dry-run Wed 4pm PT. Any blockers? :clock4:

maria (marketing): none from me. Will prototype reg page and share link.

sam (growth): no blockers. I'll have routing rules ready.

kevin (eng-ops): will need Zoom account admin to approve webhook (pinging @security if needed).

olivia (events): tagging security now. Thanks everyone — will post the dry-run checklist in #marketing by EOD.
